prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a decorative help-section icon reproduced from an approved website comp, not a new design direction.
Input image: attached b-help-icon-ref.png is the sole approved reference and edit target; its original size is 71 x 72 pixels.
Primary request: recreate the exact same complete fine charcoal-gray monoline illustration at high resolution, at least 512 x 512 pixels, keeping the near-square 71:72 aspect ratio.
Composition: a round hand-wound yarn ball sits at lower left, with crossing curved strands inside its circle and one loose yarn tail extending toward the lower right. Behind and above it toward upper right, an open rounded question-bubble loop encloses one simple question mark. Keep the relative scale, overlap, loop shape, hand-drawn contour character, question-mark shape and the original reference's slightly asymmetrical arrangement. Keep the complete icon visible with a small clean margin on every side.
Style and palette: thin charcoal-gray or very dark warm gray line work, delicate consistent monoline weight, simple organic outline drawing. No filled speech-bubble silhouette, no generic chat icon substitution, no extra motifs, no 3D, no shading, no photograph.
Background: uniform pure opaque white #FFFFFF suitable for CSS multiply blending; no background texture, no gradients, no shadow, no transparency checkerboard, no fake alpha grid.
Exact allowed readable mark: one question mark ? as the icon's visual element. Exact allowed text: empty list.
Prohibited: any other readable words, Chinese, Japanese, English letters, numbers, labels, watermarks, logos, signatures, captions, UI controls, borders or card chrome. Do not add text. Preserve the approved reference's yarn-ball-and-question-mark composition exactly.
